ux_clarity.evidence: desktop_fold.png five-second test passes: kicker LABSA 90%, headline names Gundlav (kept per demand), lead states 90 +/- 1% active matter at own plant Gundlav GIDC, Valsad, for detergent and cleaning product makers, with one solid Request a quote and a quieter See specification. Header shows only +91 97277 02597. Homepage contact band labels Plant / sales on 02597, WhatsApp is ghost, sticky .bar is Call | Request a quote (56px). Spec table now includes Packing (barrel-filled at Gundlav) and Order unit MT; plant table 350 MT / 200 MT; ISO 9001:2015 next to lab photo; chairman 25 years attributed to Binay Chandra Jha with 16 November 2019 incorporation. Walk-the-site fails that standard: labsa-90.html, manufacturing.html, quality.html, about.html, privacy.html .bar is Call | WhatsApp (filled second slot), and those pages plus contact.html still list 02597 and 01597 with no role. Packing still says ask for drum size; no MOQ. TDS/SDS/CoA are gated on contact.html.
strengths: Fold answers what / who / next action without the logo: LABSA 90% from Gundlav for detergent makers, Request a quote.
Proof sits beside claims: 90 +/- 1, barrel-filled packing, MT order unit, 350/200 MT storage, named lab kit, ISO 9001:2015, CIN U24297DN2019PTC005589.
Homepage primary path is conventional and ranked: header number is 02597 only, Plant / sales label in the contact band, ghost WhatsApp, mobile bar Call | Request a quote.

issues.where: .bar on labsa-90.html, manufacturing.html, quality.html, about.html, privacy.html
issues.problem: The previous sticky-bar fix (Call | Request a quote) exists only on index.html. Every other page uses Call | WhatsApp, and CSS .bar a+a paints WhatsApp as the filled primary. A buyer on LABSA 90% or Manufacturing cannot hit Request a quote from the thumb bar, so the site's one job disappears mid-walk.
issues.fix: Copy the index.html .bar onto every page except contact.html: first link tel:+919727702597 labelled Call, second link contact.html labelled Request a quote. On contact.html keep Call | WhatsApp because the quote form is already on screen.

issues.where: .phones on labsa-90.html, manufacturing.html, quality.html, about.html; contact.html .reach Phone list; index.html .phones .altn
issues.problem: Two equal numbers was a prior issue. Homepage header is fixed, but inner pages still show +91 97277 02597 and +91 97277 01597 with no role. Homepage labels the second number Also, which is not a job. contact.html lists both under Phone. A buyer does not know which to dial (Hick).
issues.fix: On every .phones block and on contact.html, wrap 02597 with span.lbl Plant / sales (same as index.html). Give 01597 a real role (for example Accounts) or remove it from the page if it has no distinct job. Keep the header as 02597 only.

issues.problem: Packing is Barrel-filled at Gundlav. Ask for drum size with quantity. No drum kg, no drums per MT, no minimum order. The quote field is Quantity required (MT) with hint Example: 5 MT and is optional, so a procurement buyer cannot convert plant tonnes into barrels or know the smallest lot.
issues.fix: Put the real drum in the Packing cell, e.g. HDPE drums, 210 kg net, barrel-filled at Gundlav (~4.8 drums per MT). Add a spec row Minimum order with the actual MOQ in MT. Make #quantity required and set the hint to Minimum n MT. Example: 5 MT.

issues.where: hero a.link[href='#spec']; spec p.cta a[href='contact.html']; quality.html #iso
issues.problem: See specification jumps to the on-page table. TDS, SDS and a sample CoA with your quote goes to the quote form. Quality copy also withholds the ISO certificate until contact. A technical buyer who needs an SDS for EHS before an RFQ is told documents come only with a quote, and spec means two different things.
issues.fix: Relabel the hero link Jump to specification table. Under the table state TDS, SDS, sample CoA and the ISO 9001:2015 certificate are sent as PDFs on request - call +91 97277 02597 or write send SDS in the quote form; no order required. Link the files directly if they exist.

issues.problem: Success is only Thank you. We have received your request for LABSA 90%. No who replies or when. Company name and quantity are optional on a B2B RFQ. Failed validation writes to .status without aria-invalid or focus on the empty field, so the buyer may not see what to fix.
issues.fix: On success set status to Thank you. Plant/sales will reply on +91 97277 02597 within one working day. Set #company and #quantity required. On client validation failure, mark the empty #name/#phone/#consent with aria-invalid=true and a 2px #a4260c border, and focus the first invalid control.
